description.en: Original evidence-informed stylized living reconstruction of Istiodactylus latidens, NHMUK R3877; source-supported revised diagnostic head with general conservative pterosaur body completion.

reconstruction_notes: Full body proportions, wing membranes and attachment, pose, soft tissue, colors and tooth spacing are artistic conservative completion; no complete articulated R3877 body, species-specific integument or precise membrane claim.
author: Leon Made This / s010s
acceptance_scope: Original frozen scoped independent model review with retained advisories; no blanket formal/GPU/neighbor/reproducibility or user visual approval. Website image review remains separate.
scale_scope: Nominal authored display dimensions; not new specimen metrology.
